title: Jordan's Football Association accused FIFA of blackmail, alleging it was pressured to endorse President Gianni Infantino in exchange for help with visa issues, taxes, and unpaid tournament prize money.
text:
Jordan's Football Association accused FIFA of blackmail, alleging it was pressured to endorse President Gianni Infantino in exchange for help with visa issues, taxes, and unpaid tournament prize money."

"The association said it refused to support Infantino's re-election, joining several other football federations in withdrawing their backing."

"Source: Sky News
